justification: Both show rows of standing human figures rendered in profile, which is a very generic correspondence found in many unrelated traditions. Image A is a small carved stele with hieroglyphic text, a winged disc, and Egyptian deities in a specific ritual offering scene, while image B is a large-scale architectural relief of a procession on a staircase set within a monumental complex with columns—entirely different subject matter, scale, and iconographic scheme beyond the shared generic motif of profile figures.
